description: Source code for a Kubernetes client implementation handling dynamic resource allocation, API version management, and resource interfaces.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Client struct for interacting with Kubernetes resources, managing API versions, and providing resource interfaces.

methods.name: apiName
methods.description: Returns the API version name based on the API number.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Client instance with the provided Kubernetes interface.

methods.name: CurrentAPI
methods.description: Returns the current API version as a string.

methods.name: DeviceClasses
methods.description: Returns the DeviceClassInterface for managing device classes.

methods.name: ResourceClaims
methods.description: Returns the ResourceClaimInterface for managing resource claims in a namespace.

methods.name: ResourceClaimTemplates
methods.description: Returns the ResourceClaimTemplateInterface for managing resource claim templates in a namespace.

methods.name: ResourceSlices
methods.description: Returns the ResourceSliceInterface for managing resource slices.

methods.name: IsWatchListSemanticsUnSupported
methods.description: Indicates whether the client supports WatchList semantics; returns true if not supported.
